sources.title: Low HDL cholesterol and particle concentrations are associated with greater levels of endothelial activation markers in Multi-Ethnic Study of Atherosclerosis participants
sources.population: MESA: US community participants aged 45-84 without clinical cardiovascular disease; baseline 2000-2002. Table 1 Exam 1 n=6730; HDL Table 2 n=6651 (3139 men, 3512 women). White, Chinese, Black and Hispanic participants from six communities.
sources.measurement: Fasting EDTA plasma; cholesterol oxidase method (Roche Diagnostics) after magnesium/dextran precipitation of non-HDL; assay CV 2.9%. Target is serum direct HDL with PEG-modified enzymes: numerical equivalence is assumed, not documented by a paired assay comparison.
sources.cohort_overlap: Same MESA cohort as S2; not independent replication. Source reports no target-cohort use. Potential participant overlap with the target survey is unknown and no matching was attempted.

sources.title: High-Density Lipoprotein Cholesterol and Particle Concentrations, Carotid Atherosclerosis and Coronary Events: The Multi-Ethnic Study of Atherosclerosis
sources.population: MESA baseline 2000-2002, n=5598, age 45-84. Additional exclusions: lipid-lowering medication use, triglycerides >400 mg/dL and missing required variables. MESA exclusions include cardiovascular disease, pregnancy, cancer, cognitive impairment and weight >136 kg.
sources.measurement: 12-hour fasting EDTA plasma; Roche cholesterol oxidase assay after magnesium/dextran precipitation, CV 2.9%. Measured height and weight used for BMI.
sources.cohort_overlap: Substantial overlap with S1; one MESA evidence stream. No source-to-target individual matching.

sources.title: SCARB1 single nucleotide polymorphism (rs5888) is associated with serum lipid profile and myocardial infarction in an age- and gender-dependent manner
sources.population: Lithuanian population-register sample, 2006-2008, age 25-74; reference group n=1976 (902 men, 1074 women); 60.4% of initial sample examined. Lipid-lowering users and current hormone-replacement users excluded. The separate MI case group is not used.
sources.measurement: Serum after at least 12-hour fasting, conventional enzymatic lipid methods with automatic analyzer in certified laboratory. Specific assay comparability with target unknown. Anthropometry measured.
sources.cohort_overlap: Separate Lithuanian population, independent of the MESA cohort. No individual-level records retrieved.

evidence.locator: Table 2, Exam 1 HDL-C (mg/dL) row; Table 2 caption
evidence.estimand: Unadjusted sex-specific arithmetic mean and between-person SD of HDL-C
evidence.uncertainty: Reported values rounded to whole mg/dL. No confidence intervals for these means or SDs supplied. These are SDs, not SEs. Ranges shown up to 100 mg/dL conflict with the wider HDL range in S2; do not impose a 100 mg/dL ceiling.
evidence.applicability: US multiethnic cohort and relevant measurement, but older and healthier than target, no young adults; method, specimen and period differences remain.
evidence.model_use: Anchor marginal means and total log variances under a transported reference population; medians are a distributional check only.

evidence.locator: Table 1, Exam 1 age and BMI rows
evidence.uncertainty: Rounded means and SDs. BMI-age covariance and residual predictor SDs are not reported.
evidence.applicability: Reference cohort only. Target predictors are preserved and not resampled from these moments.
evidence.model_use: Centers and scales for transforming source rank dependence and variance accounting.

evidence.locator: Table 2, BMI row and correlation footnote; Statistical Analysis section
evidence.estimand: Partial Spearman rank correlation between HDL-C and BMI
evidence.adjustment: Age, sex and ethnicity; this is not an unadjusted Pearson correlation or mg/dL-per-BMI slope
evidence.uncertainty: No CI for this correlation reported; no sex-specific correlations, conditional SDs or age-BMI covariance reported.
evidence.applicability: Older US multiethnic adults; medication and high-triglyceride exclusions limit transfer to an unrestricted adult population.
evidence.model_use: Approximate Gaussian-copula rank parameter, then converted to sex-specific log-HDL BMI slopes using E1/E2 scales.

evidence.locator: Table 1 HDL-Chol, Total rows and age-group column headers; Table 1 adjustment note; Statistical methods
evidence.estimand: Sex- and age-group HDL mean contrasts in the population reference group, pooled across SCARB1 genotypes
evidence.adjustment: Table note: data adjusted by age and BMI in each age group. Common standardization values across age groups are unspecified.
evidence.uncertainty: Table caption labels parentheses as SD; Methods says continuous summaries are mean and SE. No cross-age contrast CI or fitted age slope is reported. Parenthetical dispersion is deliberately unused; only means are used, with explicit bridge uncertainty.
evidence.applicability: Broad adult population but Lithuania, selected participation, therapy exclusions and calendar period differ. Cross-sectional age contrasts can include survivor, cohort and selection effects.
evidence.model_use: Youngest-to-oldest log mean ratio divided by age midpoint difference; middle-age means retained as a non-target interpolation check.

retrieval_summary.stopping_reason: Approved primary evidence now covers HDL scale, sex, BMI dependence and an age contrast. Preserve two queries and five download attempts for review-directed repair; the remaining structural gaps are not solved merely by accumulating unrelated papers.

revision_searches.purpose: Find explicit HDL determinants or correlates regressions rather than convert rank dependence.
revision_searches.result: Retrieved ten records from 240 hits; inspected all returned titles/abstracts. No applicable matched-population HDL regression or residual covariance estimate found. No pagination attempted after remaining query used for more focused search.

revision_searches.purpose: Find adult HDL determinants models jointly mentioning BMI and regression.
revision_searches.result: Retrieved ten records from 32 hits. Accepted records concern other outcomes, restricted disease populations or predictor indices. No matched HDL-on-BMI/age coefficient or missing source standardization reference was identified. No new article download was justified.

retrieval_summary.final_stopping_reason: Query cap reached after two review-directed searches without suitable new quantitative evidence. Five download attempts remain, but no source among returned records justified replacing the approved calibration or retrieving a new unrelated fulltext. Search failure does not imply that better evidence does not exist.
